name: Leverage Shares -1x Alphabet ETC
summary: Leverage Shares -1x Alphabet ETC is an exchange-traded commodity (ETC) designed to provide investors with a leveraged inverse exposure to the daily performance of Alphabet Inc. It aims to deliver the opposite of the daily percentage change in the price of Alphabet shares, multiplied by a leverage factor. The product is structured as a debt instrument and listed on the London Stock Exchange.
